notes.title: Character Refresh, New Key Art & New Logo!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone!

It’s been a little while since our last post here, so we thought we would pop in with a quick update. ✨
We promise that things are moving along behind the scenes. Game development can be a bit like living in a burrow! Quiet on the surface, but full of life and activity underground 🌿🌳

Today, we’re happy to share some new things we’ve been working on! 

⭐[b][i]First off: a refreshed design for our main mouse character![/i][/b] 🧣🐭
We’ve been working on updating the character art to better match the cozy storybook vibe of the world, and we’re so happy with how they’re coming to life. What do you think? 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/7ec9b14b96429919808af31542942e68e783d306.png"][/img][/p][p]⭐[b][i]We’ve also been busy updating our key art, and we’re so excited to reveal a brand new Winter Burrow logo![/i][/b]
These changes reflect the heart and tone of the game more than ever before and we hope you love the new look as much as we do! [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/1c3cae2e039e0eff7c0b34d73d84955815b4e62a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Now we know you're eager for more updates about the game, so stay tuned… in fact, you might want to keep your eyes peeled for a familiar little mouse during this [b]Saturday’s Wholesome Direct on June 7 at 9AM PT / 6pm CET streaming on both Twitch and Youtube[/b]! 🌿

As always, thank you for wishlisting, playing the demo, and just generally being excited about our game🌲🥧 

Have a mice day! 🐭[/p]

notes.title: Join the celebration of Earth
notes.notes:
I’m proud that Winter Burrow is part of the Earth Appreciation Festival on Steam—alongside so many beautiful games that honor our connection to the natural world.

Winter Burrow is deeply personal to me. It’s inspired by memories of my mom taking my sister and me to a place in the woods we called Fox Hill. We’d ride our bikes there, eat lunch at the top, and spend hours playing in the forest—building little homes from sticks and pretending we lived there.

Now I do the same with my own kids. Whenever we find a hollow tree or tangled roots, we imagine who might live there and tell each other stories. That love of nature has found its way into the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/5f40f943efc79d03ffbd47ca05f4b5dc874d5e23.png[/img]

We’ve put a lot of care into making the world of Winter Burrow feel alive and true to nature—even naming characters after real plants and animals. The Aunt is called Betulina, from the Latin name for the northern birch mouse. The toad is named Bufo, and one character’s partner is Pinesap—a parasitic plant that ties into their backstory (no spoilers!).

Nature is close to my heart, and I hope Winter Burrow brings a little of that magic to you. Maybe it even inspires you to step outside, breathe in the forest air… and then come back to your cozy burrow for tea and pie.

– Benjamin; Game Director, Winter Burrow

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/9b1e467e0dd3eaf9aadfb5a44c87bf649f16e172.png[/img]

notes.title: Long-Awaited Update
notes.notes:
We’ve been deep in the development of Winter Burrow over the past few months, which is why we haven’t posted here for a while. But now, we’ve finally popped our heads out of the burrow to have a chat!

Hello, I'm Benjamin, CEO and Creative Director at Pine Creek Games. Every day, I’m amazed by what the team designs, creates, and develops. We’ve added more creatures that now roam the world. NPCs have come to life through character descriptions and dialogue. New areas with their own unique environments are growing out of the once-blank canvas. New features have been designed and implemented.

These are some of the things I'm most excited about! 😊

I’m incredibly excited about our new Weather System. It adds so much atmosphere to the game while introducing unique gameplay experiences. Imagine exploring a new area in thick fog or getting caught in a fierce snowstorm—these are now dynamic events you can encounter in Winter Burrow. But don’t worry, we won’t throw a blizzard at you right away! We’ll make sure you’ve had time to settle in before the weather turns wild. ⛄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/1a422297949b64fb6bbeb04f06c2537f08f5550c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/7ccecd08a5dc6dd98832aee07a334d2849e78ac5.jpg[/img]

We’ve also improved the Furnishing System, allowing you to customize your home burrow to your heart’s content. We’ve designed different furniture sets, each with its own distinct style and requiring unique resources to craft. The system is designed to be simple—so we can develop it within our timeline while ensuring stability—but it still offers plenty of ways to arrange furniture and decorate your space just the way you like. You can also easily disassemble or move furniture if needed. It’s still in development, but here’s a little preview of our progress:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/c60d6189269ffc0aaba4295165f910e2ce449d7a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/77a9b9be3baf75d520d7dc6f0b2eeeabb019e49b.jpg[/img]

Now, I’ll crawl back into the burrow and continue working on the game. We can’t wait to share more with you about all the new features and content. That’s all for now—remember to drink some hearty tea, enjoy a delicious pie, and most importantly... stay cozy!

Have a mice day! 🐭

notes.title: In this cozy survival game you're a mouse who knits tiny wool sweaters, bakes pies for his friends, lives in a furnished tree trunk, and I can't even go on because it's so darn cute
notes.notes: One of the reasons I love survival games is there's something inherently cozy about them. You may struggle and starve and bleed, but at the end of a long perilous day when you decompress in front of a fire with a belly full of food in a shelter that keeps out the cold and rain (and sometimes the monsters), what could possibly feel more safe or satisfying than that?.. notes.title: End of Winter Borrow demo - for now
notes.notes:
Thank you all so much for your support and feedback during the Winter Burrow demo! We're incredibly grateful for the time you took to play and share your thoughts with us. Now, it's time to take the demo down *for now*, but here’s what we’ve learned:
[list]
[*] The sound: Wow, way too loud! We apologize for that. We should have tested it better, and we’ll make sure to fix this in future builds.
[*] Keyboard controls: We hear you! While our initial focus has been on controller support, especially with the exciting Xbox partnership and Gamescom booth, keyboard controls will absolutely be included in the final game.
[*] Co-op requests: That sounds super fun. However, for now, we’re concentrating on delivering a fantastic single-player experience with our small team.
[*] Localization: Yes, the game will be localized! We’ll keep you updated when we have more specifics on the languages.
[/list]

We’re already working on a new demo based on your feedback, and we can't wait to show you the new features. Once we have a release date, you’ll be the first to know!

Thank you for being part of our journey, and after the whirlwind of Gamescom and Pax West, we’re eager to dive back into game development. Stay tuned for more updates! 💖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/83d87c79c79a893b6a5263acade6d9b510799d12.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Meet the NPC named Moss
notes.notes:
[h2]Presenting Moss[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/03ef0bc7493809adc34b257ef3475a5b24a0bb64.png[/img]

Say hi to [b]Moss[/b], the new NPC in Winter Burrow. They are a part of a hedgehog couple who live a nomadic life collecting different types of animal fur tufts to use for exquisite woolen yarn for their beautiful knitwork full of patterns and colors. 🧶🦔

They have come to your area to find the highly insulating white fur of the snow hare. 🐇 Their partner, Pinesap, is the one who does the exploring and searching for fur tufts left behind on branches and bramble by a passing animal. When we meet Moss they are awaiting their partners return. 

When we did some research on animal sizes, it surprised us that the hedgehog was so big compared to the birch mouse. At first we though it could pose a problem having an NPC that much bigger than the main character, but we realized it could be an advantage. 🐁🦔

[b]Our Lead Artist Lucy puts it this way:[/b]
[i]"We really wanted to show some different animals in the game and Moss is the first one you come across. With our birch mouse hero being so small, we wanted to give context by showing you how you compare to other creatures you will be encountering in your adventure.

What we also wanted to show in the character design was Moss' personality, being dependant on their partner and a little bit unsure how to spend their time alone, keeping to their tea and knitting."[/i]

A tiny bit of story spoiler below:
[spoiler]We won't spoil the whole story about Moss and Pinesap here, but as Lucy brushes upon, there is an unbalance in their relationship that has made Moss very dependant on their partner and where Pinesap might have exploited that to some degree.[/spoiler]

All NPCs in the game has something they can help you learn to better survive the wilderness. Moss will love to pass on their knowledge of knitting, yarn and all the stuff you can make with that. Moss and Pinesap have made knitting into an artform. 

[b]As Lucy writes:[/b]
[i]"The clothing is inspired by the Sami people, showing off the intricate patterns and beautiful designs Moss and their partner dedicated their lives to."[/i]

We look forward to show you Moss in the game and to tell you the story about Moss and Pinesap and to show you how it all ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/e5c2a67764783388fa29043bad822dce45f14268.png[/img]

notes.title: Welcome to Winter Burrow
notes.notes:
Hallo, 

Benjamin (he/him) from Pine Creek Games here👋🌲🎮

First of all, thank you so much to all of you who have showed interest in our game Winter Burrow and thank you for all the kind words. It warms extremely much and it motivates all of us from the team to know, that what we make resonates with others.

It's crazy to think that in 2019 the first sketches were made and the first funding application sent and now 5 years ( and three kids ) later we are here. It all began while I was playing a lot of survival games and started imagining what a survival game with woodland creatures would be like. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/ca28905867bc4e4f8b670bd2255312fb592f7824.jpg[/img]

I remembered when my mother took me and my siblings to the forest and we would sit on the moss and play for hours with small twigs and leaves pretending we were living on the forest floor. It was amazing and I wanted to transfer that feeling into a video game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/4ecdd3bd5a1a2b30d6852d672dc05e3adcb8e1da.jpg[/img]

Though I understand the purpose of and appreciate the punishing and relentless nature of most survival games, I had felt a growing need for games where I didn't loose everything in a death I barely anticipated, but where there were still challenge and depth. 

All these things became the spark that made Winter Burrow the Cozy Survival Game it is now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/91d91058eece76ddbe481c905c68cae97ca19108.jpg[/img]

We still have the majority of development in front of us and we look forward to every part of it and to share the progress with you. Pine Creek Games consist of and amazing team of people working fully remote from around the world. We try our best to keep a healthy work/life balance and we appreciate that we can be diverse and have an inclusive and friendly work environment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/e4f645b8a321e9f0f82e0bde53a87c47d8d371eb.jpg[/img]

A huge thank you to my partner for your support and to my kids for reconnecting me with the childish imagination of playing. Also a big thank you to our publisher Noodlecake for beliving in our game and us and to Xbox for supporting us all the way to our announcement. 

If you feel a connection with the idea of playing a mouse who lives in an tree stump home in the middle of the woods, feel free to join and follow us on your preferred platforms below:

Benjamin
